key_points: Intel shares down ~4% after Elon Musk hinted TSMC may join his Terafab venture, raising competitive concerns.
Recent earnings showed revenue beat but an $11 billion loss, weighing on sentiment.
Profit‑taking after a sharp 9% rally earlier in the week added to selling pressure.
Analysts note the foundry turnaround remains uncertain amid potential TSMC‑Musk collaboration.
No material change to Intel’s long‑term product roadmap; news is mostly short‑term noise.
